description: Upload a media file to the Cosmic bucket from a URL or base64-encoded data. Requires write access.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., "image/webp"). Defaults to the URL response Content-Type or the data URI MIME type.

filename.description: File name to store, including extension (e.g., "cover.webp"). Defaults to the file name in the URL, or a generated name with an extension from the MIME type.

media.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch media from, or base64-encoded data with data URI prefix (e.g., "data:image/png;base64,...")

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the media file

trigger_webhook.description: Whether to trigger webhooks on upload

name: cosmic_media_upload
title: Upload media
